title: Extra technicians show as +N, and hovering shows every name
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order with more involved technicians than fit in the avatar row.
custom_steps:
1. View the avatar group with overflow.
  2. Confirm the first avatars show followed by a +N indicator.
  3. Hover each visible avatar (its own area) to see the name.
  4. Confirm every involved technician is discoverable by name.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When there are more avatars than fit, the first avatars are shown followed by a "+N" overflow indicator.
  • Every involved technician stays discoverable by name.
  • Each visible avatar's own area is its hover target.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10050 — Story 7 Line technicians on cards and rows. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S7-R4, S7-R6, S7-R2 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R4: “When avatars exceed available space, show the first avatars followed by a +N overflow indicator.”
  • S7-R6: “Keep every involved technician discoverable by name.”
  • S7-R2: “Use each visible avatar’s own visible area as its hover target.”
